wave1.observation: A simple naming turn took 17.8 seconds and used a model-tool-model memory path; a current-conversation correction also invoked session search once.
wave1.userImpact: Simple conversation feels slower and more mechanical than expected.

wave1.observation: Latest-document work remained correct but two internal tool attempts failed before recovery.
wave1.userImpact: Correct result is preserved, but avoidable attempts add latency and cost.

wave1.observation: Three-turn mixed-document journey took 167.5 seconds; the deliverable turn took about 84 seconds.
wave1.userImpact: Accurate complex document work is too slow for comfortable interactive use.

wave1.observation: A prominent image number was retained as a cautious 41,3xx possibility rather than read exactly as 41,300.
wave1.userImpact: No hallucinated certainty, but image-based business facts may require better visual observation.

wave1.observation: First Web answer took 32.1 seconds and included one readable source that was not used in the final answer.
wave1.userImpact: The result is correct, but one avoidable read delays a simple current-news request.

wave1.observation: One future-described event was phrased as already opened, and one official supplemental source remained snippet-only after static read blocking.
wave1.userImpact: Time-sensitive wording can overstate status; partial source coverage must remain explicit.

wave1.observation: Two early parallel lanes cleaned their isolated console state before visual review was requested.
wave1.userImpact: Machine results exist, but the human cannot inspect those exact console conversations.

requiredInputs: sequential Web and large-file timing anchors
batchPlanning.plannedOutput: One bounded refinement plan grouped by demonstrated common defect families, with explicit non-goals and no change to unrelated later Gates.
